Dear Hiring Manager, 
Born to do this work. I bring a fixed income trading and data perspective that aligns with 
Bloomberg Enterprise Data’s mission, and I’m excited to apply as Product Manager for 
Fixed Income Reference Data. 
Why I’m a strong fit 
• Fixed Income expertise: Deep knowledge across corporate credit, municipals, 
securitized products, and rates; understands pricing, risk, and regulatory data 
needs in trading and risk workflows. 
• Enterprise data product track record: Led end-to-end data initiatives, defined 
requirements, translated business needs into actionable plans, and prioritized 
features for client impact. 
• Technical foundation: Proficient in Python and SQL; cloud experience 
(Azure/Linux); strong in data pipelines, ETL, normalization/linkage, and agile 
delivery. 
• Customer-centric leadership: Direct client engagement, feedback-driven 
solutioning, and collaboration with Marketing/Sales to drive adoption. 
• Cross-team execution: Led multi-region programs (APAC, EU, US); aligned 
roadmaps with regulatory and market developments; effective stakeholder 
management. 
• Bloomberg alignment: Commitment to data quality, timely delivery, and high-
touch client service; ready to grow Fixed Income Reference Data offerings and 
client value. 
What I bring to the role (mapped to requirements) 
• Fixed Income knowledge across multiple areas (Corporate Credit, Municipals, 
Rates) 
• Enterprise data product experience and understanding of how clients evaluate 
datasets and data pipelines 
• Python, SQL, cloud exposure; data integration and pipeline concepts 
• Agile experience; collaboration across Engineering, Support, and Data 
Operations 
• Clear communication for plans, updates, and business cases 
• Proven client-facing success and strategic partnership development 
Next steps

• I’d welcome the opportunity to discuss how my fixed income trading background 
and passion for fixed income data can drive adoption and growth for 
Bloomberg’s Fixed Income Reference Data. 
Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to speaking with you. 
Sincerely, 
Anil Sharma Anil.ons@gmail.com +31-626882437 LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/getanil

Consent form for travelling abroad with a minor
• If you pass through border control with a minor, you must be able to show that you have the consent of the child’s 
parent(s) or guardian(s) who are not travelling with the child. 
• You can use this form to show this. Your passage through border control will be quicker if you have the form with you.
• Complete a copy of this form for each child. After filling in the form, print and sign it. 
• If you have any questions, visit www.travelwithchildren.org. Or call the Dutch International Child Abduction Center’s 
travel question hotline (+31 (0)88 800 9000).
